question.text: Ms. Neha Desai, Compliance Officer of Aravalli Long-Short Fund, is drafting the PPM under SEBI's February 5, 2020 template. Which of the following is NOT among the Section-A disclosures prescribed by the template?

answer.text: Conflicts of interest and procedures to address them
Distribution waterfall for each class of units
Daily real-time trade blotter of the fund's last 30 days of orders

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.5 lists the prescribed PPM Section-A content including executive summary, market opportunity, investment strategy, governance structure, track record, principal terms, NAV determination (for Cat III), conflicts of interest, risk factors, legal/regulatory/tax considerations, fees illustration, distribution waterfall, disciplinary history, glossary. A daily trade blotter is NOT part of the template. The Trap: Options A, B, C are explicit Section-A items. Option D sounds plausibly 'transparency-like' but is not required and would be commercially infeasible. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C covers the same template across all categories. XIX-D adds drawdown/commitment disclosures. XIX-B tests what the distributor is allowed to extract from PPM for client-facing materials. Manager's Pro-Tip: Trade-level transparency is provided via the quarterly reporting and the annual PPM audit, not the PPM itself. Keep intraday order-book data firmly behind prime-broker confidentiality and SEBI reporting-only channels.
